title: Stand-up: API migration done, demo moved

segments.x: Morning. The API migration is done, all endpoints are on the new version since last night.
The rollback plan is written down too, just in case.
Great work. Any errors in the logs since the switch?
Two timeouts, both on the reports page. That's what worries me: the new queries are heavier.
The client asked to move the demo. They want the twenty-third now, in the afternoon.
The twenty-third works for me. I'll review Ben's pull request before that.
And let's check the database load on staging this week.
I'll send you the load test numbers tomorrow.
Can someone book the big meeting room for the demo?
